name: Vv'viza
description: An Illvoi who took over Uthros Combine leadership after Mm'menon's exit and counters Mm'menon's attempts to glean its secrets.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vv'viza takes over leadership of the Uthros Combine after Mm'menon's flight.
timeline.quote: Vv'viza eagerly stepped up to fill the void of leadership left in their absence.
